study: One controller episode recorded with everything the README dashboard shows: the actor's per-button probabilities, the critic V(s) fitted on the published clearance returns, the buttons the emulator actually received after the published reflex overrides and the jump edge-trigger pulse, the tile patch and camera the actor does not see, an RGB frame, the section-4.1 identity residue of each step, and the paused-player flag of 10.59 together with the operator's A presses that clear it.

protocol.savestate_route: entered through the world map; the survey's own capture step saved the state 180 frames after the fade in, before the handoff probes
protocol.reflex_overrides: hazard within 75 px and grounded, or a right wall while grounded
protocol.jump_pulse: B released on every even frame while held and grounded
protocol.operator_rule: once the 12D record has been identical for 130 frames the operator pulses A (4 on, 4 off) up to 120 frames; A is not in the six-button action set, so this is an outside-the-policy takeover and it is recorded per frame, not folded into the actor's actions

frame_capture.note: 0 = 0RGB1555, 1 = RGB565, 2 = RGB888; the two differ because the core asks for a 32-bit buffer and hands back a 16-bit one
